goal: Decide how to run a small product launch this week

lines.say: I need to sort out a small product launch this week.
There are three things: the launch day, support cover, and the announcement.
Let me think through the day first.
Okay, decided: we launch Thursday morning.
Three people are on support that day.
They can answer the first questions.
By the way, I really want hot pot tonight.
Please look up what time of day launch emails get the most opens.
While that runs, let me keep thinking.
The announcement should be short and clear.
With five people on support, the weekend is covered easily.
Right, it's three, so weekend cover will be on-call only.
I need to write a short launch email to customers by Wednesday, saying what's new and that weekend support is on-call only.
I still don't know if marketing can review it in time.
